card.line: Raamses, also spelled Rameses, was a store city in Egypt that the Israelites built for Pharaoh while they were forced to work as slaves.

moments.title: Slaves build a store city
moments.text: The Egyptians put taskmasters over the Israelites to oppress them with forced labor. They built Pithom and Rameses as store cities for Pharaoh. The more the Israelites were oppressed, the more they multiplied.
